Definition: from G32; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept:--message.
BiblicalUsage: John writes that the message we have heard from the beginning is that God is light and in Him is no darkness at all. The word is the announcement itself, the thing declared and handed on.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for the message itself carries no teaching of its own; its weight is John's, that the message is simple, God is light, and we are to love one another.
